subject: Mythology
title: Druids: Priests, Judges, and Scholars
description: A quick win: understand Druids: Priests, Judges, and Scholars.

hook.text: Druids were the most powerful people in Celtic society — more respected than kings and feared by all.

buildup.text: They served as priests, judges, doctors, and teachers. Training to become a druid took twenty years of study.

discovery.text: They memorized vast libraries of law, history, and mythology because writing sacred knowledge was forbidden.

twist.text: Romans feared druids so much that they specifically targeted them for destruction during the conquest of Britain.

climax.text: The druid tradition was nearly wiped out, but fragments survived in Irish monasteries and Welsh poetry.

punchline.text: They stored an entire civilization's knowledge inside their heads.

quiz.question: How long did it take to train as a Celtic druid?
